meta.name: Manon Of The Spring
meta.description: In this, the sequel to Jean de Florette, Manon has grown into a beautiful young shepherdess living in the idyllic Provencal countryside. She plots vengeance on the men who greedily conspired to acquire her father's land years earlier.
meta.slogan: They destroyed her father. Now they offered her love. But the only thing she desired was revenge.
